homeHelp: Catalog, loans, reminders, and clearance for this school.
catalogHelp: Search by title, author, or accession number. The accession number is the barcode.
title: Title
author: Author
subject: Subject
noSubjects: This school has no subjects yet.
noSubjectsHelp: A book can still be saved as general. Subjects are added on the subjects page.
circulationHelp: A loan is 14 days. A patron with an overdue book cannot take another one.
noPatrons: This school has no patrons yet.
noPatronsHelp: Students and staff are added on their own pages.
intakeHelp: Copies move from the store into the catalog. The accession number is the item code, and the quantity leaves the bin card.
noItems: The store has no items yet.
noItemsHelp: Add the book in the store before taking it into the library.
remindersHelp: Opening this page records a reminder for a loan that is due today or overdue. There is no background job.
patronsHelp: Sign a patron in and out. A student sign-in is a library visit. The book title is the reading note.
resourcesHelp: File a teacher recommendation, or add a resource for the teachers of this school.
literacyHelp: One report per student for the current academic year. It counts visits, returned books, and books still out. Print it for the parent. The parent site is not part of this screen.
noStudents: This school has no students yet.
noStudentsHelp: Add a student before writing a literacy report.
recommendHelp: Suggestions come from marks under 50, the student's grade, and titles teachers recommended. This is not a trained model.
checkoutHelp: Scan or type the book accession and the patron card. A student card is the same code as the digital ID.
scanMissing: This browser cannot read a code from the camera. Type the code instead.
scanHelp: The first scan is the book. The next scan is the patron.
reservationsHelp: A patron can reserve a book online only when every copy is out. Ready holds it. Collect lends it.
competitionHelp: A visit is 2 points, a returned book is 10, and a late book costs 5. 20 points awards member. 50 awards scholar. Opening this page records a new badge.
clearanceHelp: A student with a book still out cannot be cleared. Returning the book removes the block.
opacHelp: Reserve a title only when every copy is out. A copy on the shelf is borrowed at the library desk.
